audit: Cadence audit (MS-G), 2026-08-05: which registered results have per-chunk cost in a denominator, and which of those ran at unrecorded toy chunk weight (B=4/K=32)?
trigger: P39 (a)/(c): exp_d forwarded only --d-model to its subprocesses, so every 'd=128' run measured toy chunk weight regardless of what the parent was told. Ratios roughly halved once measured at real cadence (17.9->7.1 / 3.79->2.2), and both checks remained failed — bc9bb3c, d0123a1.
method: Scanned every results/*.json for embedded (batch, chunk) configs; grepped PREDICTIONS.md for cost-ratio metrics (ms/chunk, chunk slots, cpu/wall ratios, tok/s, stall, replay, snapshot cost); classified each registered claim by whether per-chunk cost sits in its denominator.

findings.status: RESOLVED before this audit: re-measured at production cadence on two machines; falsified as registered; register updated (7d85218).

CLAIMS UNAFFECTED: every registered P38 check is an exactness or heldout comparison (six-decimal behavioral identity, bit-identical catch-up, sleep-vs-idle heldout), none gates on a cost ratio. The descriptive timing side-numbers in those artifacts (transfer_s, catchup_s) ARE toy-weight and must not be quoted as production costs.

findings.family: Möbius staging (P39d expectation: sync debt bounded)
findings.cost_in_denominator: partially — debt dynamics depend on relative machine rates, which depend on chunk weight
findings.status: PARITY UNAFFECTED (delta 0.0 at chunk 560 is an exactness claim). The sync-debt magnitudes and B-overtakes-A dynamics are toy-weight quantities; the rate-matched rerun (MS-C+I) must set the cadence explicitly. moebius_stage.py now forwards --batch/--chunk-size (defaults unchanged).

findings.cost_in_denominator: tok/s and grad-token fractions appear, but batch/chunk were ALWAYS explicit CLI args recorded in every status JSON

findings.status: NOT APPLICABLE: claims are recall/fidelity, never cost ratios.

findings.ran_at: own explicit configs (8/8192 eval; 8/64 lifetime, recorded in run header)
findings.status: CLEAN: memory and PPL claims; wall-clock numbers are descriptive.

systemic_gap_found: The portable_organism result JSONs never RECORDED their cadence at all — the config lived only in snapshots. Any future reader auditing those artifacts cannot see the 4/32 from the result file itself. Rule added to DECISIONS.md.
rule: Any metric with per-chunk cost in its denominator is meaningless without (batch, chunk, d_model) recorded IN THE SAME ARTIFACT. A run inherits its cadence silently -> the number it produces is about the default, not about the system.
conclusion: One family affected and already resolved (P39 cost checks); one family partially affected in its side-quantities (Möbius debt dynamics; parity untouched); everything else either never had cost in a denominator or always recorded its cadence. No further register entry requires correction.
